name: Slideshow Curtain Wipe
description: Full-screen image slideshow where a colored curtain sweeps vertically across the screen between slides, with parallax and slight rotation on the images. Driven by wheel, touch, drag or buttons.
contents: Colored curtain panel used for the transition
Previous and next round buttons with a scroll hint label
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer gestures move to the next or previous slide
Current slide exits upward while its image shifts and rotates, then the curtain leaves and the next slide enters with an eased reveal
Input is ignored while a transition runs
editableByProps: Background, curtain, text and button colors
Transition timing, easing, parallax and rotation
Navigation buttons visibility, size and hint text

needsCodeEdit.where: yPercent tweens inside the navigate function
currentRef.current assignment in the navigate function

fixed: Gesture input is captured on the component container only, page scroll is not taken over
Fills the viewport height with h-screen
Slides are background images with no alt text
